S4 E23 — The One With Ross's Wedding Part 1The gang, minus Phoebe and Rachel, travels to London to prepare for Ross' wedding. While in London, Chandler gets annoyed with Joey's overexcited antics.

S4 E24 — The One With Ross's Wedding Part 2Phoebe tries to get in touch with someone to warn them that Rachel's on the way to the wedding. Meanwhile, Ross and Emily's parents meet at the wedding rehearsal dinner.

S5 E2 — The One With All The KissingRoss continues to try and mend his marriage to Emily. When Chandler accidentally kisses Monica in front of everyone before leaving for work, he tries to recover by kissing everyone.
S5 E3 — The One-HundredthPhoebe goes into labour and is stuck with a doctor who is obsessed with the show Happy Days. While Phoebe delivers triplets, Joey experiences his own pain from kidney stones.

S5 E4 — The One Where Phoebe Hates PbsThe gang discovers that Phoebe hates PBS after Joey agrees to help out with a pledge drive. Emily tells Ross she'll give him a second chance only if he cuts all ties with Rachel.
S5 E5 — The One With The KipsChandler and Monica plan a trip to Atlantic City for some private time. Ross has to tell Rachel that he can't be friends with her anymore.

S5 E6 — The One With The YetiMonica and Rachel are afraid of a hairy new neighbour until he gets a haircut. Phoebe is surprised that she enjoys wearing mink. Ross confronts Emily and refuses to stop associating with Rachel.

But after losing consciousness in the woods, David wakes to discover that eight years have passed - even though he's still 12. What exactly happened? With the help of his now-16-year-old younger brother and a robot named Max, he'll find out and hopefully set things straight. (Joey Cramer)

Black Manta seeks revenge on Aquaman for his father's death. Wielding the Black Trident's power, he becomes a formidable foe. To defend Atlantis, Aquaman forges an alliance with his imprisoned brother. They must protect the kingdom.

As a war between humankind and monstrous sea creatures wages on, a former pilot and a trainee are paired up to drive a seemingly obsolete special weapon in a desperate effort to save the world from the apocalypse. Starring Idris Elba, Charlie Hunnam and Rinko Kikuchi.
In the world of The Purge, Ryan, Marcus, Esme, and Ben learn that some lines can't be un-crossed.
The fallout from the elimination decision see Islanders face off in a best-of-three challenge to secure their place in the game. Who will be dumped from paradise?
The Villa is split into two teams for the ultimate team challenge, 'Sweet Spot'. There is a new Power Squad and they earn the right to choose four Islanders to face a duel.

The world's oldest Mickey Mouse animation cel, Pokémon collectors who turned their passion into one of Australia's most-trusted brands and a Star Wars LEGO galaxy so amazing, it must be seen to be believed.

Giselle is terrified of spiders, but her friends want to help her get over her fears. Nyla also has to get over her fear of cutting her hair if she wants to rock the new VIP Pets trend.

The stage is set for a masquerade tournament, but the Dark Prince isn't the only belle at this ball! Enter: the masked Blader known as 'Quadra.' Wielding her elemental Bey, Lightning Pandora, Quadra has defeated every foe to come her way.

Armed with Emperor Might, a revolutionary new Bey, Team Persona undergoes intensive training for their X Tower showdown. Facing the Kurosu Clan in a two-on-one battle, Persona fights for the future of X City.

From the invention of the wheel to rockets soaring through space, we explore the game-changing transportation innovations that redefined trade, warfare and global connectivity, shaping the course of human civilisation across time and space.

S3 E14 — The Boiling Rock Part 1Sokka & Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda.They develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there...

S3 E15 — The Boiling Rock Part 2This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

S13 E22 — My Friend Patty / Fun-BelievableSpongeBob befriends a sentient Krabby Patty whose only wish is to be eaten. // Rube hosts an episode of FUN-Believable! With Rube where he explores little known oddities and attractions.

S11 E8 — Sanitation Insanity/ Bunny HuntWhen Mr. Krabs gets in trouble for littering, he makes SpongeBob and Squidward clean up Bikini Bottom. A sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute!

S11 E9 — Squid Noir/ Scavenger PantsWhen his clarinet goes missing, Squidward must become a hardboiled detective to find it. Squidward sends SpongeBob & Patrick on an increasingly difficult scavenger hunt to get them out of his hair.
S11 E10 — Cuddle E. Hugs/ Pat The HorseSpongeBob's new friend is a giant fluffy hamster. There's one problem, though: no one else can see him! Patrick wants to be a horse!

S11 E11 — Chatterbox Gary/ Don't Feed The ClownsGary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm. Everyone loves it... except for Squidward! When a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes them under his wing.

S11 E12 — Drive Happy/ Old Man PatrickSpongeBob can't drive, but you don't need a license to operate a self-driving car! Patrick thinks he's an old man, so it's up to SpongeBob to remind him how much fun being a kid can be!

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

Chris makes a special trip to Karara to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

Chris travels to Edgars Mission, where he is faced with Ben Hall, a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

Chris help a seabird named Bill on Christmas Island. A Shih Tzu, arrives in respiratory distress. Meanwhile, Tim heads to the zoo to give a feisty resident a pedicure. Chris finds out if cavoodle Lola’s bark is worse than a bite.

Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. They take him to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

Chris heads out to sea to save an endangered grey nurse shark entangled in fishing line with a hook in its gob. He's joining a specialist rescue team in the water to corral the injured shark and bring it to the surface.

Chris is helping at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedge cutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

Chris is helping at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

A frail joey orphan's brought in after his mum was hit by a car. Sandy's determined to give the little battler a chance, and Chris faces a challenge repairing his broken leg—it's heart-stopping when he finds if the risky surgery worked.
A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

A groundbreaking operation is happening at the Bondi clinic: Elroy, the out-of-control bulldog is being desexed, and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen. There are some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that's wandered way off track.

On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner. Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi's most delightful dog-loving eccentrics, and a cutting-edge solution for a record-breaking goat.

p.t: Hot Roads - The World's Most Dangerous Roads
p.d: The Halsema Highway, situated on the island Luzon, leads right through the Philippine jungle with its frequent fog and heavy rainfalls. Every trip on this so-called road is an adventure and highly dangerous. We accompany a bus driver and a taxi driver on their challenging trip across the mountains.
Adventurer Francesca Chiorando jets into Belfast-which was once one of Europe's most volatile cities-to track down ex-terrorists.

Local Exploring in Tokyo is like nothing else! Josh and Lexie Limitless visit the crowded streets, a screaming Monster Café and an abandoned Love Hotel.
Cody is back in Nikko, Japan where he reunites with Sherman Mak to explore a derelict onsen and an amusement park called Western Village.

p.t: Hot Roads - The World's Most Dangerous Roads
p.d: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa.

Nearly six years of our lives are spent dreaming. Yet there is so much untapped creative potential in our dreams. What if we could take the brilliant ideas from our dreams and turn them into reality? How can we make our dreams more meaningful?

No one lives forever, but scientists will never stop trying to combat aging. Now, laboratories around the world have been successful with rejuvenation in animals such as mice and fruit flies. If animals are living longer and healthier lives, can this research benefit humans?

The story of the Antonov An-225, a relic of the cold war era aircraft made in the Ukraine that still flies challenging missions today. It is the biggest airplane in the world and holds the most air records for cargo lift.

While the graphic art of Ancient Egypt is very familiar, little is known about the artists and scribes. Who were they? How important were they to the Pharaohs? From Saqqara to the Valley of Kings, explore the lives of our first historians on record.

It took a long time for vertebrates to really take over the land, but once they did, there was no turning back. Reptiles seemed to win the race, some becoming the biggest creatures to ever walk the Earth. Dinosaurs dominated for 150 million years, but they weren't alone.

Ice is the deadliest enemy. Former soldier and archaeologist Ben Timberlake is on a mission to reveal the ice's role in wars past, present, and future. From hunting lost WW1 bunkers in Italy, to secret Cold War nuclear bases in Greenland's ice, to modern-day Arctic espionage on Russia's border.
The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system. Innovators are searching for new ways to capture more of the sun's power, and make it available through the night, everywhere.

As the bluefin fishery reaches its mid-season peak, three centuries-old fishing strategies compete for dominance. Joe banks on instinct, Tyler uses science to gain the upper hand, and strongman Niko relies on legacy -- but nobody relies solely on luck.

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm
p.d: In May 2022, an unstable weather system moves north from Tornado Alley and spawns a deadly twister that tears through Gaylord, Michigan.
When Tim and Howard head to FDR's summer home in Georgia, they uncover a Prohibition-era mystery that could have triggered a presidential scandal.
The Raneys arrive in Missouri to see a family that has just survived a tornado. Living in a crumbling cabin, they also have no clean water source.

Josh Gates investigates three aquatic mysteries: the Kraken, Lake Lanier and Atlantis. From terrifying sailor lore, to a deadly lake's dark past, and a lost city beneath the sea, he searches for evidence behind legends shaped by fear, myth and history.

A recent UFO sighting in Phoenix leads Chuck and the team to Sedona, Arizona, where these kinds of incidents occur on a nightly basis. They investigate whether the area's powerful energy vortexes are portals for otherworldly visitors.
After an informant relays a story of an alien that reportedly escaped from Area 51, Chuck and the team head to Tonopah, Nevada, to investigate whether this creature still roams the area.
When Doughboy's new Impala is finally ready to start up for the first time, the whole family gathers to celebrate.
JJ and the crew head west to meet with some Arizona racers led by old acquaintance Mary. But the trip is off to a bad start when a truck breaks in transit.

Looking into what happens if a Cummins diesel engine is put into a 2004 Lamborghini Gallardo; a customer wants Wide Open Garage to turn an old, rusted Chevy truck into a lifted, all-terrain truck on huge 74-inch tires.

p.t: Diners,Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation
p.d: Guy Fieri's checking in with a s'mores French toast tower in Boston, braised bison in Duluth, and outrageous sausage gravy burgers in Indiana.
Fieri's at a bistro is slingin' herbaceous octopus, and an Argentine joint is firing up chimichurri chorizo.
The remaining teams take on massive crowds and amusement park chaos at Dollywood in Pigeon Forge, TN. Guest judge Arnold Myint.
Arthur St. Antoine ventures into the wild Death Valley, California. To explore this unforgiving environment, Art enlists the off-roading prowess of the Ford SVT F-150 Raptor.
Jonny Lieberman and Justin Bell take a V12 G65 AMG through Sweden to AMG's Winter Driving Academy and the Arctic Circle.

One crushed project means new parts for another. The guys take on a NASCAR stock car piloted by Corey LaJoie around Atlanta Motor Speedway. How? By recycling the supercharger from their wrecked T-Bird and slapping it on a '78 Ford Fairmont.
EGT's are important when it comes to making horsepower. Jared and Lou perform an experiment on a Shelby GT 500 to see how much lower they can get engine temperatures with a water-methanol injection.
Jared and Lou explain the difference between a street legal track and a regular car with a 2017 Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R and two performance engines.

The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up a staggering amount of time against one of the coolest '66 Mustang GT350s you'll ever see.
Freiburger and Finnegan get more than they bargained for as they revive a very rusted-out '69 Mustang with a 302 V-8.

Twenty years back, Bill started Ekstensive Metalworks by specializing in lifting, lowering and everything in between. Fast forward to today, and he's still being put to the test with a 1928 Ford Rat Rod, a 1942 Ford pickup and a 1975 C10.

The shop is gearing up for the annual SEMA Show in Las Vegas, and this year Dave is bringing seven cars. Once the cars are readied, placed in their booths, and the show is running, the guys get a chance to check out some of the new builds.

Stone discovers that the once straight-A student had started down a path of self-destruction and was estranged from her parents who never reported her missing.
An obsessive executive for a worldwide delivery company finds himself stranded on a desert island after his flight home for Christmas ends in disaster.
A man takes a TV show host hostage after he loses all of his family's money on Wall Street due to a bad insider tip.
During the 19th century, the son of Irish immigrants and his band of outlaws become folk heroes after a series of daring bank robberies.

p.t: In the Name of the Father
p.d: An Irishman and his three friends get wrongfully imprisoned for a fatal IRA bombing in a Guildford pub with a coerced confession, resulting in the imprisonment of his father.
A first-year music student wins a seat behind the drums in a jazz band led by a teacher who uses fear and intimidation to push his students to perfection.

Peaceful farmer Benjamin Martin is driven to lead the Colonial Militia during the American Revolution when a sadistic British officer murders his son.
A bitter instructor employs violent fighters in his quest for revenge against the karate student who humiliated him.

A suave bank robber attempts to pull off another heist while being hunted by the US marshal he once took hostage. Federal agent Karen Sisco falls for his charms while determined to put the notorious Jack Foley behind bars.
The prison release of an old nemesis puts a federal witness on the run, with his girlfriend of 15-years earlier in tow.

A New York bookie and his pal turn a Las Vegas casino into an empire, until someone's money-hungry wife helps bring it all down.
A Navy lawyer tries to prove two Marines, accused of beating a comrade to death, were following their commander's orders.
Two Miami cops must switch identities while searching for a large quantity of heroin stolen from police headquarters.
Loose-cannon cops Lowrey and Burnett reduce Miami to rubble as they try to stop Cuban and Russian drug smugglers from flooding Florida with ecstasy.

p.t: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
p.d: Narrowly escaping an attempt on his life, Indy finds himself in India with a nightclub singer, Willie, and Indy's sidekick, Short Round.
Shrek faces his greatest challenge yet: the in-laws. Shrek and Princess Fiona return from their honeymoon to find an invitation to visit Fiona's parents, the King and Queen of Far, Far Away.
Shrek and friends set out to find Fiona's slacker cousin, Artie, and bring him back to rule the land of Far, Far Away.
Shrek makes a deal with an embittered Rumpelstiltskin that lands him in an alternate reality where he was never born, and faces a race against time to break the spell and rescue Fiona.
Ian Malcolm reluctantly returns to an island off Costa Rica's coast where cloned dinosaurs are flourishing.
Imprisoned within the Great Wall of China, a mercenary warrior joins forces with an elite army to battle an onslaught of marauding monsters.
Just as the people of Amity Island are getting over the grisly events of the shark attacks of four years ago, another great white arrives to terrorise the holidaymakers.
Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when an old video game magically transports them to the jungle world of Jumanji and transforms them into their adult avatars.
The world's last dragon and the knight who tried to slay him unite to vanquish the evil king who betrayed their trust.

Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine whether human beings are to remain the apex predators.
Fast-talking fish Oscar becomes a big hit down in the reef after taking credit for killing a shark, but his luck runs dry when Great White boss Don Lino finds out.
An orphaned dinosaur and his new friends face a danger-laden journey to a beautiful, food-rich valley.

p.t: The Land Before Time XIV: Journey of the Brave
p.d: After his father doesn't return from an important journey, Littlefoot and company set out to find him.
On a camping trip, the all-American Henderson family run over the legendary Bigfoot. Taking him home to suburbia was a mistake though: he's loveable, but he's a seven-foot wrecking ball.
Rough and ready mercenary Rick O'Connell bites off more than he can chew when he inadvertently resurrects the ruthless mummy of High Priest Imhotep.
Rick O'Connell returns to Egypt for a second crack at the evil Imhotep, who has enlisted the dark services of the Scorpion King and his army of jackal warriors.

Police try to help a man who claims he intends to kill himself and anyone who comes near him. Officers check individuals for drugs and weapons. Cops question two men suspected of stealing a lawnmower.
Deputies deploy a taser on an uncooperative man after a pursuit. A man accused of sexual battery is arrested. Two men are arrested for their warrants. A high-speed chase ends in a violent crash.
Following the Department of Homeland Security Customs and Border Protection agency as they operate on the 28 bridges connecting the United States of America and Mexico.
Join Rob Lemoto for a closer look at the dramatic working lives of New Zealand's police force and the Kiwis who end up on the wrong side of the law.
Join Rob Lemoto for a closer look at the dramatic working lives of New Zealand's police force and the Kiwis who end up on the wrong side of the law.
The motorway is shut down so a team can rescue horses from a crashed horse float; a man is supposed to be the sober driver, but he doesn't stay that way.
A passenger hopes for a smash hit for her rap, GPS distraction causes a crash, and police discover fake rego labels made with sticky tape.
Flip the ignition and prepare for a brand-new episode of Caught On Dashcam. From nail-biting near misses to encounters with things that go bump in the night, we’ve got it all caught on camera!
A man struggles to correctly do a drug test and blames cold and flu medicine for his less than desireable results.
One job leads to a completely different one for officers as they spot some dodgy activity behind their car.
Follow members of the Victoria Police Highway Patrol as they intercept traffic and other criminal offenders on major highways. Officer Alasdair Farrell is called to a traffic incident at a school.

Officer Megan de Winne is dealing with an unlicensed driver in a suburban street and notices a car circling the block. While she's questioning the occupants the situation gets tense and then a scuffle breaks out.
The Special Operations Response Team is called to a fall on Arthur’s Seat. Meanwhile, in Aberdeen, a student paramedic faces some difficult patients on her final training shift.
A look at how Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team deals with trauma incidents.
The team must work together to help a student after multiple seizures. All hands on deck to keep a man alive & a mountain biker has suspected spinal injuries after a race.
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.
Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world's 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.
The true story of seasoned deep-sea divers who battle the raging elements to rescue a crewmate who's trapped hundreds of feet below the ocean's surface.
The mother of an abducted boy, who has been legally declared dead, hires an alcoholic cop to reopen the kidnapping case.

A couple realise their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

p.t: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
p.d: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

p.t: How to Lose a Popularity Contest
p.d: Overachiever Ellie teams with slacker Nate to sabotage her ex in the class election, but unexpected sparks threaten her meticulously laid plans.
In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal and the family faces financial trouble.

Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.
An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.
The inspirational true story of Munroe Bergdorf -- author, model, and leading transgender activist.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.
Three sisters return to their childhood home for a momentous occasion: the third wedding of their twice-widowed mother.
A writer on the verge of releasing his new novel is pulled into caring for three eccentric older women and his own mother during one chaotic weekend in Dublin.

A couple realise their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

p.t: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
p.d: An advice columnist attempts to make a man dump her in 10 days, but he makes a bet with his boss that he will make her fall in love with him.
Facing a crossroads in her life, a divorcee travels to Italy, India and Bali on a quest to change her life and find true happiness.
In 1943, an American girl's baseball team form their own professional baseball league when the men are away fighting in WWII.

Luke Harrison leaves his wife Jackie for Isabel Kelly, but his kids adore Jackie, and the career-minded Isabel is the most unsuitable of stepmums. When Jackie falls dangerously ill, Isabel must adopt her mantle as a true mother to the bereaved children.

Happily married couple Diana and David Murphy head for Las Vegas, hoping to win big on the tables. The gamble, however, proves disastrous, but enigmatic millionaire John Gage offers the couple $1 million for a night with Diana.
Young Maya pesters her dad to tell her why he's getting divorced, so he tells her the story of his (love) life. Has he missed out on his soulmate?

While their children are at summer camp, a married couple try to remember why they fell in love.

After his younger brother dies in an accident, the dreams of an accomplished sailor die with him. The two brothers meet in the hour before each sunset, but when a former classmate returns, he must decide whether to let romance help him move on.

A security repairman stationed on a desolate future Earth rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. Her arrival will trigger a chain of events that will leave man's fate in his hands.
A couple's trip to Amsterdam becomes a life changing journey for their relationship.
When two newlyweds go broke in Las Vegas, a stranger offers them a million dollars to spend a night with the wife. I'll fix their finances, but at what cost?
As war rages in Europe, a Nazi-scalping squad of American soldiers, known to their enemy as The Basterds, is on a daring mission to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.

After a catastrophic crash, a pilot discovers he's stranded on Earth - 65 million years ago! With only one chance at rescue, he and the other survivor must cross a terrain riddled with dangerous prehistoric creatures.
Remi has her life planned, until carefree Barnes turns it upside down. As love grows, she must choose: follow her path or risk it all for the unknown.

An extraterrestrial finds a friend in 10-year-old Elliot, while members of a task force work day and night to track down the whereabouts of Earth's first visitor from outer space.
Elphaba's journey toward becoming the Wicked Witch and her evolving bond with Glinda continue in the second chapter of the film adaptation of the Broadway musical.
As they return to Jumanji to rescue one of their own, nothing is as they expect. They will have to brave parts unknown and unexplored to escape the world's most dangerous game.
A slick, young Navy lawyer is assigned to investigate a murder case in which two Marines killed a fellow enlisted man, and no one's talking.
A promising jazz drummer enrols at a cut-throat music conservatory where his immense talent is mentored by a fearsome teacher who'll stop at nothing to realise his student's potential.
When genetically modified dinosaurs run amok at a new themed resort, a former military man and animal expert must use his special skills to halt an all-out prehistoric slaughter.

The intensity rises at Extreme Barcelona as elite BMX, skateboarding, scootering and other athletes push creativity, skill and progression to the limit. Parc del Fòrum hosts spectacular international battles, live on FUEL TV.

p.t: Great Skateboarding Cities of the Summer - Barcelona
p.d: S1 E1Tyler Surrey, Enrique Lorenzo, Jose Roura, Anthony Claravall, Thomas Winkle and more break down the rich history of Spain's skateboarding Mecca. From the classic spots we know today, going all the way back to the OG parks (Turo Park) and contests you might have never heard of.

p.t: The Moto: Inside the Outdoors: A Waking Giant
p.d: S2 E6An inside look at one of the most grueling professional race series in the world; the AMA Pro Motocross Series.

p.t: The Moto: Inside the Outdoors: Never Enough
p.d: S2 E7An inside look at one of the most grueling professional race series in the world; the AMA Pro Motocross Series.
S2 E7Jeff King and a 20 ft tall genie have three unforgettable sessions with wake skater Nick Taylor, the Signal and Omatic snowboard teams, and skateboarder Bob Burnquist.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Giving Our All
p.d: S1 E5This episode highlights the Norco Race Division's journey to the World Champs. Greg retires after an epic 28th race in Andorra, while Gracey places fourth, showcasing resilience and skill as the world's fastest female downhiller, making a stunning comeback after her injury.

Indulge in the safety of your own living room as the Storm Show crew basks in the heavenly depths of endless powder days, big lines and even bigger airs. Follow stuntman/speed-flier Matt Combs as he skis and soars off of previously untamed lines that end in massive and unsurvivable cliffs.  Death-defying skier Mike Tierney continues to stack up first descents on the exposed faces of Cody Peak, skiing the "Talk Is Cheap" face and launching into "Central Couloir", a feat only previously accomplished with a rope rappel. Seasoned veterans Andrew Whiteford, Ryan Vanlanen, and Lindsey Dyer show why they've devoted their lives to the eternal powder quest. These are the Magic Moments we dream of, ready for the willing.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Pottz Classic
p.d: S3 E6The crew leaves the comforts of a 5 star hotel to stay at a local hostile right in front of one of South Africa's greatest right hand point breaks. Rudy's Backpackers is one of the most famous hostels in South Africa, owned and operated by one of South Africa's top big wave riders. The crew settles right in, and with five people to a room the humor begins to unfold.

S1 E3There are places that take you back in time - like Morro do Moco, Angola's highest mountain, where you'll find a community disconnected from the rest of the world, living as they did a century ago. To get there, surfer and storyteller João Kopke went through several realities very different from his own.

p.t: Camp Woodward: Kids Will Be Kids
p.d: S2 E3Larry adjusts to working at camp, while Cody tries to figure out the best way to bend the rules. Hunter finds a slice of home with his older buddy and pro Joe Rich.
S2 E4Cody demonstrates why he is the next generation of skater in the Playstation Am Jam. Hunter tries new ramps, and Larry works hill duty and discovers campers sneaking out.

S1 E3Greyson Fletcher lives loud and skates even louder. This Portrait dives into his explosive mindset, surf-rooted upbringing and raw approach to skating, from Burnside sessions to his take on skate culture, social media and living life at full speed.

S1 E4Sebo Walker returns to Portland, the city that shaped him. This Portrait follows his journey from years chasing skate dreams away from home to reconnecting with family, community and his roots, while continuing to skate with purpose and bring a positive energy to those around him.

S1 E5Steve Caballero reflects on life beyond skateboarding, from the final Combi Pool Party to new passions in motocross, art and music. At 60, Cab shares how skating shaped his path and how bands like Faction and Urethane keep his creative fire alive.

S1 E1Portraits follows Aaron Jaws Homoki beyond the biggest drops, exploring his Arizona roots, local skate scene and life off the board. From choosing home over California to reflecting on injuries, friendships and purpose, Jaws opens up about what still drives him.

Jason along with daughter Haily, visit a house to investigate child ghosts who occasionally bounce balls and are heard walking back and forth on the third floor. Jason allows Haily to take the lead on her first investigation, as he believes that child ghosts are more apt to make contact with younger females. The group just might have thought correctly after Haily hears whispering voices.
The TAPS team is the first paranormal team to ever investigate the famed Friar's Club in New York City. Next, the team travels to the Main Street Armory in Rochester, New York.
Ghost Hunters, the team heads to Rapids Theater in Niagara Falls, New York where a lonely actress hanged herself backstage. The staff believes her spirit has never left and is haunting the theater.

Special guest investigator Meredith Vieira joins the TAPS team, as they investigate Sailors' Snug Harbor in Staten Island, New York. Once a retirement home to weathered seaman, it's now home to the spirit of a murdered matron.

TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri, to investigate the notorious Missouri State Penitentiary. A prison that was once named one of the most violent prisons in America. Riots, stabbings and executions left thousands dead over the years -- resulting in an abandoned prison full of ghostly inmates.
TAPS heads back to the fan favorite; Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, an abandoned tuberculosis hospital haunted by its former patients and staff.
The team visits Kentucky to probe a distillery where the ghost of a colonel may lurk and to investigate a nightclub with a grim past.

TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity.
TAPS travels to “Christmas City” to investigate hauntings believed to be caused by two kids trapped in time.
TAPS is investigating a haunted amusement park that has a restless spirit yearning to stay on the rides. Later, a family is frightened in their home and call on the Ghost Hunters for help.

Tonight the Ghost Hunters visit a hotel haunted by the spirit of a suicide victim, and later come to the rescue of a couple that is ready to leave their home because the paranormal activity is too much to handle. Don't move! Call the Ghost Hunters!

TAPS investigates the Hales Bar Dam And Marina in Guild, TN, where for the first time, TAPS will take their cameras underwater to search a graveyard that was flooded when the dam broke. Built on former Cherokee land, the dam is said to be cursed by a fallen Indian Chief.

TAPS heads to Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, where the Thomas House Bed and Breakfast apparently has guests that don't want to leave. Leave this realm, that is. Built in 1890 by the Coyd family, many members of the family died in the house and are causing the current owners, the Cole family, great concern. The Cole family now own the building and want to know what exactly is haunting their home and business, and what can they do?

TAPS travels to Virginia in order to investigate Major Graham Mansion, a historical location that has seen hangings, madness and murder and is thought to be haunted by spirits that include Major Graham's wife and a small girl who was buried nearby.

TAPS heads to Providence City Hall to investigate claims that a former mayor is haunting the building. The team then travels to Farmington, NY to help a couple whose 4-year-old grandson is traumatized by spirits in their historic house.

After country singer Will Brown’s wife passes, his grief stalls his career and strains his bond with his young daughter—until a talented horse trainer guides him toward strength, forgiveness, and a new start in life.

Aurora Teagarden has a passion for solving murders. After an exhaustive search, she buys her dream home, unaware of its murky history and she discovers the family who once lived there mysteriously disappeared without a trace.

This is the record of a road trip with a difference – taking a Harley where it was never designed to go. Country music artist Steve Grace had a dream of riding his motorbike from Byron Bay to the Birdsville Hotel in remote Outback Queensland, along the way telling the stories of the hardworking people he encountered.

Since 1970 the Hour of Power has been reaching viewers from around the world. Originally founded by Dr Robert H Schuller, the program became the most-watched religious program in the world, reaching 17 million viewers. Now under the leadership of Bobby Schuller, Dr Schuller’s grandson. The congregation worships at Shepherd’s Grove Church in Garden Grove, CA. The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.

Direct from Houston, Texas, USA; join Joel and Victoria Osteen and the team from Lakewood Church, for this program of powerful music and empowering preaching. Experience from the weekend church service of Lakewood Church, the largest and fastest growing church in America that is inspiring millions of people around the world!
This week we revisit the work of ReLove, and encourage social enterprise using the Helping Hands Domestic Violence Study Guide. helpinghands.tv

Dot Conner is the world’s first “webtective,” a detective who uses the internet to solve mysteries, and in Dot’s experience there are no bigger mysteries than the questions she has about her Christian faith.

p.t: Home Is Where the Heart Is
p.d: In this heartwarming reality series, actor and skilled craftsman Luke Macfarlane rolls up his sleeves to help transform not just houses, but lives. Each episode of Home is Where the Heart Is follows Luke and designer Olivia Westbrooks as they team up with families, couples, and individuals whose homes are in need of a little love and a lot of heart. From small-town cottages to countryside farmhouses, Luke leads stunning renovations that honour the personal stories behind every space - proving that a home’s true foundation isn’t brick or timber, but connection, memory, and love. This feel-good renovation series seamlessly blends emotional storytelling with inspiring design. Expect surprise reveals, meaningful reunions, and plenty of joyful tears as Luke and Olivia help turn each house into a true home - one heartfelt makeover at a time.

Discover enterprising people in the most influential spheres of modern society: arts, entertainment, and business. From New York to Paris, we visit exclusive places that challenge our perceptions of the Holy Ground.
We like to call it 'soul food'. LIFE TV uses creative illustration, real life stories and biblical teaching to encourage and help viewers discover a greater purpose to their lives.

p.t: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
p.d: Dr. Jeremiah serves as host and teacher during this musical tour of our eternal home with special guests, including Veritas and Taranda Greene.

The In Touch program reaches the world with the Gospel with messages that tackle such issues as parenting, finances, personal crises, emotions, and relationships. Dr. Stanley fervently believes the Bible to be the inerrant Word of God, a belief strongly reflected in his teaching. Dr Charles Stanley is the author of more than 50 books.
Gary Hoogvliet, a very tall man, interviews interesting folk, not quite as tall as he, but nevertheless with fascinating and inspiring stories to tell.

p.t: Signed,Sealed,Delivered: A Tale of Three Letters
p.d: The POstables are back identifying the intended recipients of a trio of dead letters which have a surprising, personal impact on all of them. Stars Eric Mabius, Kristin Booth, Crystal Lowe, Geoff Gustafson, Rhiannon Fish.

The best-known Christian evangelist of the 20th century, Billy Graham gained world attention in 1949 with a tent revival in downtown Los Angeles that was scheduled for three weeks and lasted six. In the ensuing 55 years and more, 'Billy Graham Crusades' consistently drew audiences of thousands to arenas and stadiums throughout the world.'Classic Crusades' presents the best of the last 35 years of Billy Graham that brought the message of salvation through Jesus Christ to the world. World renowned actors, singers, athletes and ministers share the platform with Dr. Graham. Also often features the famous sounds of the Billy Graham Choir, George Beverly Shea and Cliff Barrows for an hour of blessing and inspiration to all who watch.

Deborah is disturbed when her critically injured boyfriend tries to break into the morgue. Plus, paranormal activity hits the dialysis clinic.
Big scares come in small packages—a ghostly girl follows a care-home housekeeper, disembodied footsteps trail a hospital balloon, and a pint-sized angel of death appears.
Nurses' aide Emily senses a foreboding presence stalking the hallway of a care facility. Nurse Kaitlyn notices not all residents move on after death.
Cross paths with lingering souls—a nurse believes cold spots are a stuck patient's spirit, trauma binds the dead to the living, and a ghost can't exit a hospital café.
At an overnight treatment centre, youth worker Melissa has a frightening encounter during the night shift. Nurse Linda sees spirits roam her hospital.
A resident at a care facility reveals a phantom child is asking her for help. The spirit of a patient returns to get the last word in with Nurse Meg.
Teenager Annibeth gets a tour of a psychiatric facility and is terrified to discover the rumours about the building being haunted are true.
When multiple residents report a nighttime intruder, Janet wonders if the disturbance she feels has a paranormal connection.

Legend says Ashmore Estates is shrouded in shadows and mystery. But as the team investigates, they uncover a haunting with a purpose; one that runs deeper than ghost stories and reveals a reason that changes everything.

Return to Ashmore Estates with the team and follow the trail to Robbin Terry’s home, the R Theater. Witness eerily similar paranormal activity, which points to another mysterious connection and a shocking revelation that no one saw coming.

Tour the infamous Pauly Jail in Union Springs, Alabama, where Shane once had a life-changing experience. Listen as chilling voices echo through the abandoned cells, and spirits desperate to share their secrets stalk the investigative team.
Explore a woman’s haunting legend and her ties to Savannah’s Sorrel-Weed House.
Visit a shrine where all faiths converge, then stand back as the team discovers a tear in its spiritual shield. Witness a powerful ritual that changes Dave forever and watch hidden secrets surface.
Search for the source of echoing voices and sinister shadows in an old hospital.
A young couple fear their 5 month old baby is the target of an evil spirit and Deanna Dunkle is attacked by dark shadows lurking in her home.

The group dynamics are drastically changed when Chef Ramsey asks for a volunteer to switch sides. This week's challenge consists of creating 4 new dishes from 20 ingredients. One chef requires a medic after injuring himself during the challenge.

It's all about speed and accuracy as the teams are challenged to prepare dishes in a relay race. The winners are treated to a day of fun in the sun as they head to the beach for private surfing lessons. The losing team is forced to get down and dirty and clean the entire restaurant.

To give the remaining chefs a little added inspiration, Chef Ramsay takes them to the future location of The London West Hollywood; while in the kitchen, a chef burns his hand and the others struggle to deliver food to the diners in a timely manner.
Chef Ramsay orders the five remaining chefs to teach cooking-impaired housewives to prepare a gourmet meal. The winner receives culinary pointers from chefs Mark Peel and Ben Ford.
The final four contestants prepare lunch for surprise guests: eighty picky pregnant moms. The chef whose dish they favor wins a $1,000 shopping spree. The others must clean up.

Chef Ramsay surprises the Final 3 chefs by bringing in a few special guests to join them for a breakfast he prepared. After the guests leave, Ramsay asks the chefs to recreate the signature dish they just ate. This challenge throws a couple of the chefs off their game.

The final two chefs prepare for their ultimate challenge. They must design their restaurants as well as create a winning menu. But they won't be there to oversee the renovations- Chef Ramsay flies them back to the Borgata where they compete to wow the Hotel's CEO with their signature dish.

The two finalists, Petrozza and Christina, pick their teams for the final dinner service. Petrozza selects Ben, Bobby and Jen, while Christina goes with Corey, Louross and Matt, hoping to keep him on form with encouragement.

Sixteen new contestants step into the kitchen to prove that they are worthy of the head chef position; creating signature dishes turns into a team challenge with men versus women; one chef goes head-to-head with chef Ramsay in the elimination round.
Gordon Ramsay challenges the hopefuls to make a perfect prawn dish. Winners get a high-flying meal out, while losers are stuck on prep. Will their second night of service go smoother than the first?

Gordon Ramsay's cookery competition gets an early start as contestants serve breakfast to firefighters. The losers clean the fire engine with messy results, before knuckling down for evening service. Who will impress Chef Ramsay?

Gordon Ramsay's chefs compete for the top job at Araxi in Whistler, BC. Their first task is making sausages before tackling evening service. When one contestant gets bad news from the doctor, can he push through?
Gordon Ramsay challenges the remaining chefs to cook a meal for a Marine returning from Iraq. The winners score an aerial adventure, while one team bombs at evening service. Who's going home?

Cooks compete for the head chef role at Araxi. The teams must create a three-course meal under 700 calories. Winners score a sporty prize, while one loser cracks under punishment. A disastrous dinner service brings shocks at elimination.
Teams face an alphabetical challenge. Winners score a Vegas trip, while losers get an early wake-up call and heavy prep. After a patchy dinner service, who gets sent home?
Erin's friend asks Ben and Erin to turn a dated, well-kept house into a Southern-inspired forever home, but surprises lurk beneath the surface.
A Dallas couple plans for the future when both their mothers will move in, and they're searching for a home for everyone in Tulum, Mexico.
Tarek and Christina are lured to North Hollywood, CA, by a 1930s Spanish home.
Despite working long hours, a young couple couldn't afford to buy a home in pricey San Francisco. They're hoping for a bargain in Edinburgh, Scotland.
Tarek and Christina take a risk on a huge home in Anaheim Hills, CA, in hopes of making more money after sharing the profits.
Jack continues his hunt for wild homes, beginning with a trio of wooden geodesic domes. Next, he tours a home that's top to bottom marble.
With so many flips in play, Tarek and Christina take out an expensive, hard-money loan to flip a house in Fountain Valley, CA.
Tensions rise as a woman's fisherman husband angles to trade space and privacy for an oceanfront spot in Puerto Morelos, Mexico.
Tarek and Christina get a smoking deal on a Yorba Linda, CA. They spend big money to remove a fireplace.
After years of hard work, a couple makes the move from Alabama to roll tide in Maui, Hawaii.
Tarek and Christina find a small house in Lakewood, CA, to flip quickly.
The hilarious, surprising, and bizarre behaviour that takes place after dark... because when the sun goes down, the neighbourhood gets wild.
Unanticipated failures, schemes going sideways, and good intentions gone wrong. Life is most entertaining when nothing goes according to plan.

p.t: My Lottery Dream Home: Where Are They Now?
p.d: David Bromstad hops in the time machine to catch up with past winners in Massachusetts and Cleveland.
Comedians D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola explore California's High Desert rentals, including a lazy river resort and an artsy animal sanctuary.
1968 was a year marked by assassinations, a contentious presidential election, an escalating anti-Vietnam War sentiment, and more.
They fought their way through Europe, survived overwhelming odds, liberated concentration camps, and drank a victory toast at Hitler's hideout.
Revisit the rise and fall of the Inca Empire with new discoveries that challenge old myths of ruthless giants.

December 1914. After 5 months of war, both the Germans and the Allies have dug themselves in behind impenetrable lines. Faced with this siege, the soldiers will bring back into use an old weapon that they will modernize: mines, blowing up enemy fortifications from beneath...
Examine Qin Shi Huangdi, the man who united, and indeed gave China its name. His legacy includes the Great Wall and his astonishing tomb, guarded by the Terracotta Army.
Explore Clinton's transformative, controversial presidency. Learn about his upbringing and public career.
In the 17th century, as the smoke cleared from the civil war, the first celebrity criminals emerged. Mounted soldiers from the losing royalist armies turned to a life of crime, becoming 'Highwaymen'.
Charting the devastating impact pirates had during an age of colonial expansion.
Sam Willis explores urban crime, fraud and corruption in the eighteenth century and uncovers a fascinating rogues gallery of charmers, fraudsters and villains.
Athens, a small hamlet in its early days, was established on abandoned land in 3,000 BC, but it would be transformed into one of the greatest ancient cities in the 5th century B.C.
4th century B.C.: Alexander the Great sets out to transform a fishing village into the ancient world's most dazzling city; feast your eyes on a reconstruction of the city and its amazing buildings.

p.t: Landslide: The Presidency of Herbert Hoover
p.d: President Herbert Hoover presided over the Great Depression before losing his reelection bid to FDR in 1932.
The Nazi regime spread terror across Europe, as Hitler's promises of greatness and racial purity secured public support while enabling horrific eugenics programs and inhumane medical experiments.

p.t: Kanji Ishiwara: The Man Who Triggered the War
p.d: World War II started when Manchuria was invaded by a now-forgotten Japanese general: Kanji Ishiwara.
Operation Tiger was a D-Day rehearsal, but a Nazi E-boat attack resulted in the loss of 749 American G.I.s.

Shadow Mike and the team as they inspect a disintegrating ceramic tile floor that was supposed to be an upgrade. Put on your hard hat and sniff out the reasons why the pieces are developing hairline cracks in unexpected places.

Get to work when Mike and the team step in to redo a terrible tile job and complete an abandoned kitchen reno. Meet a generous tile supplier and the emotional homeowners, all of whom are thrilled to have the job done right.
Single mom Debbie discovers her home inspector didn't do his homework. Mike conducts a full Holmes inspection, with his team patching her leaky basement and roof and warming up her icy living room.

Shawn and Francesca's inconsistent HVAC system is suffocating their love for their dream home. Mike uncovers problems their home inspector missed and sets his crew to work helping them breathe easier.

First-time buyer Dan's new townhouse has a sewer backup stinking up his basement man cave plans. Mike and the crew uncover why his home inspector's quick-fix advice and missed issues just don't cut it.

Kelly and Brian's home inspector sailed right over a flooded backyard, odd laundry room and chilly bedrooms. Mike assesses the damage before Damon and the crew help these new parents keep their heads above water.

Mike repairs the geothermal heating system making winter miserable for Izabela and Waldemar, who skipped a home inspection after a bidding war. Along with Damon and the team, he sets out to make their green-home dream a reality.

Mike picks up where Stuart and Kim's sloppy home inspector left off, spotting roof holes where critters and drafts are sneaking in before the Holmes team issues an eviction notice to the squirrels and the cold air.

Mike Holmes has decided that he wants to build his dream garage on his own property, and he wants his son, Mike Jr., to help him in the endeavor; in fact, he put Mike Jr. in charge of the entire build, and he cannot wait to get started.

A woman calls on host Mike Holmes to help with her cold, unsafe basement after a hired contractor pours a new foundation that turns out to be too small and causes the upper part of the house to hang over the poorly planned groundwork.

Experience the transformation from house to home when Mike takes over a renovation stuck in limbo. Follow the Holmes team as they finish construction and make it possible for the homeowners to begin healing from the heartbreaking loss of a loved one.

Intervene in a half-done reno that Mike deems a disaster in the making. See how the team breaks the string of bad luck following a homeowner who has already faced an electrical fire, a personal tragedy, and an untrustworthy contractor.

Unearth the toxic mess buried in the backyard of an already fire-damaged home. Watch Mike and the team clean up the previous contractor’s sloppy remediation work, then discover another underground surprise: a hazardous, leaking oil storage tank.

Flush out the reason why a newly built home has needed eight bathtubs in just two years. Discover what’s leading to warping, buckling, and mould growth, then cheer as Mike’s smart fixes help pull the plug on the homeowners’ frustration.

Shadow Mike and the team as they inspect a disintegrating ceramic tile floor that was supposed to be an upgrade. Put on your hard hat and sniff out the reasons why the pieces are developing hairline cracks in unexpected places.
Police investigate a Kentucky dental assistant's life after finding her in a well.
A missing pregnant woman sparks fear and suspicion in a small Indiana town.
O.J. Simpson steps back into the spotlight with a hidden camera prank show. As producers push for shock and spectacle, footage reveals rising tension.
O.J. Simpson performs pranks for a hidden-camera show, exposing uneasy encounters and a carefully crafted persona that begins to crack under pressure.

p.t: Evil Lives Here: The Killer Speaks
p.d: Growing up, Ashley is a bright kid, but as she grows, she becomes violent. When she brutally murders her grandmother, she tears the family apart.
Tina Swor and partner John Dalton start a new life in Spirit Lake, Idaho. But John's erratic behaviour and love of guns plague their fresh start.
YouTuber Randy craves control and online fame but struggles to make real friends. Reality gets complicated when his fantasies begin to creep in.
When Cincinnati Reds player Dernell Stenson goes missing, teammates demand answers. An investigation turns up a shocking murder.
During week two of Juiced, production captures O.J. Simpson's drunken descent as he revisits his past. O.J.'s girlfriend shows up on set with bruises.
With the final sketch in freefall, O.J. Simpson's volatile outbursts and signs of abuse rattle the crew. Tensions mount until the shoot implodes.
When Debbie Fagan is found shot to death in her car, the town of Monrovia, Maryland, fears the worst. Who would want to do this to a mother of two?

On January 2nd, 2020, fifteen-year-old Kristen Galvan disappears a month after she was rescued from a sex trafficking ring in Houston, Texas. As her mother desperately searches for her, she uncovers the dark and unforgiving world of human trafficking.
After Andrea Knabel vanishes, her close friends and family rally together to find answers. But unsettling rumours and a social media frenzy begin to overshadow the search.
The search for Andrea takes a dark turn when the volunteer group Missing in America begin to suspect one of their own. Plus, a fresh set of eyes joins the case.
A routine traffic stop leads to a deadly discovery in a suburban home in Massachusetts, and officers realise they've apprehended a serial killer.

Andy And Ben explore Bruny Island, forage native foods, cook wallaby over fire, hunt at night, then wrap up Tasmania with a tomahawk feast.
Andy cooks with Duncan Welgemoed at Africola, visits Udder Delights, then heads to Jacob's Creek to blend wine and create the perfect grazing board.
Andy explores the Clare Valley with chef Dan Moss,visits local mushroom,grain and lamb producers,then cooks smoky lamb ribs paired with regional wine.
Andy explores the Yorke Peninsula,harvests oysters,cooks blue swimmer crab pasta,then forages with Quenten Agius before cooking fresh local butterfish.
Andy reunites with Ben in Melbourne for dining at CODA, a city food crawl and a night exploring Melbourne's vibrant cocktail bar scene.
Ben treats Andy to pancakes before they explore Melbourne's coffee culture, discover fermentation in Daylesford and cook a wood-fired vegetable feast.
Andy And Ben visit an open-range egg farm,runs a breakfast taco stall at Warragul Farmers Market,then finish with a stop at Four Pillars Gin in Healesville.
Andy returns to Bondi, visits Pocket City Farm with Mark LaBrooy, then cooks wood-fired cauliflower and BBQ jerk chicken at Three Blue Ducks.
Andy and Mark hit the road, visit the Knafeh Bakers, learn dumpling making in Rylstone, then fish with Andy's dad and cook beachside flathead and chips.
Andy cooks beachside in Coffs, explores Byron's food scene, visits Three Blue Ducks, markets and Salumi Brothers before crossing into Queensland.
Andy explores Brisbane with rooftop beekeeping, Urbane dining and Scenic Rim limes before cooking honey-glazed pork neck at Sunny Coast farm.
Andy leaves Falls Farm, flies to Fraser Island, fishes, sandboards and cooks snapper sashimi and whole red emperor at a remote eco lodge.
Andy And Ben reunite in Cairns, swim Crystal Cascades,forage and cook crab at Cooya Beach, cook at Nu Nu, then end their road trip on a helicopter trip.

Andy explores kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf and learns pickling on Kangaroo Island. He visits the d'Arenberg Cube for a Chef's Table experience before finishing at Wirra Wirra winery to cook flatbread and enjoy local wines with the team.

Andy forages in Kakadu with Dewayne Webb for a buffalo cookout before hitting Darwin to help Zach Green with indigenous street food. He then catches barra with expert Rob Johnson and BBQs it at Anbangbang Billabong to cap off the trip.
Host Emily Calandrelli delves into the world of satellites.

Emily meets with a team of scientists to discuss the dynamic, explosive, and dangerous center of the Solar System: the Sun. Plus, we explore the threat that two types of solar explosions can pose to us here on Earth.
Canadian engineer Denis Boivin has invented the track n Go which makes it possible for any 4x4 vehicle to become a snowmobile in 15 minutes.
Gravity Sketch is an intuitive multi-platform 3D creation tool developed by Oluwaseyi Sosanya and two other students of the Royal College of Art.
Rob McCall has built a futuristic catamaran super yacht that looks like something that would transport a James Bond villain to a secret location.

Tear hails from New York City and is a 52 blocks master, a defensive fighting style invented by African Americans in prisons. Instead of hitting, you block.

Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

The discovery of CRISPR Cas-9 in 2012 opened up seemingly limitless potential in the field of genetic editing.
Modern warfare spans land, sea, and air. This episode explores training for Full Spectrum Warfare across all environments.

A year and a half later, Jane, Rachel and Lorinska are back with babies who've grown into toddlers. And surprise -- there's a new mum to meet!
Little Penelope gets a big-girl bedroom, and Lorinska takes Iva bra shopping. Jane looks for a house and starts planning her Spring Carnival outfits.

Once a seaside retreat for 19th-century yuppies and later a suburb defined by the heroin addicts who flocked there, St Kilda has endured a constant cycle of boom and bust – today it is again one of Melbourne’s most desired addresses.
City of Churches it may be, but Adelaide has always been a strange mix of progressive politics and small-town parochialism. Adelaide has had its share of drama too.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim visits the West MacDonnell Ranges in Central Australia to discover its wildlife, amazing geography, and the story of its people.

p.d: Encounter some rare exotic cats in Tasmania, and learn why this island looks a lot like Australia used to look before the introduction of feral pests. Then return to the reptile park, where Tim and his team get ready for bushfire season.
The team shows off a number of dazzling flowers, including rhododendrons, vibrant peonies, orchids, and tulips; a trip to one of Australia's most beautiful country towns.
Using chocolate, the remaining dessert makers must produce their most swoon-worthy creation. The two weakest will head straight to the Zumbo Test, where a truly monumental challenge awaits them.
The jury, including Babe and Bondi, arrives in West End, Brisbane, at the final instant hotel belonging to Terry and Anita. Who will be given the title of Best Instant Hotel?
On a quest to look hot for race day, Rachel tries cryotherapy. Iva confides in Lorinska and wonders whether Rachel and Jane like her or not.
Love guru Lorinska decides that the girls' sex lives need some serious sprucing. This queen bee takes matters into her own hands and shuffles the ladies off to the fish markets.

A dog-walker receives a lesson in first aid to prepare for any emergency situation; Dr. Scott meets a spaniel with bad breath due to infected teeth; Emma, the head vet nurse, heads to a local donkey sanctuary to do some volunteer work.
Tonight, the contestants must create the ultimate kids party cake. Adriano Zumbo and Rachel Khoo won't be the only judges; they've called in some tough critics - kids!

Jean Johansson helps Lorraine and Jon chase their dream of a Spanish getaway home among the whitewashed mountain villages of Axarquia.
Lorna and Gordon can't wait to retire and move to Spain, where they are looking for their new dream home in their favourite resort of Benalmadena on the Costa Del Sol.

p.d: Aspiring interior designers transform a variety of spaces from dowdy to delightful as they vie for a life-changing contract with a top hotel in London.

Stevie Adams is a real estate agent and still can't work out why her three-bedroom town house isn't selling. It's in Oxenford near the Gold Coast theme parks, a place where homes usually sell within 30 days.

p.t: Love It Or List It Australia
p.d: Rob and Nikkis Waverley home is struggling as a family property. Andrew and Neale face a challenge unlike any they have tackled before.
Claire and Lisa are building their dream home on a picturesque 10 acres of Victoria's Mornington Peninsula. Armed with an environmental conscience, they plan a modernist house.

p.t: I Bought It At Auction With Sarah Beeny
p.d: In the South Downs National Park, Michelle and Derek take on a cosy cottage in need of some TLC. Archie and Lauren try to add value to their Somerset fixer-upper.

p.t: Kirstie & Phil's Love It or List It
p.d: Kirstie and Phil help Karol and Richard in St Osyth. Karol wants to list their dated bungalow; Richard wants to renovate. Can Kirstie make them love it, or will Phil find a new home for them?
We revisit Robin and Colin nearly 10 years after their search for an architectural gem. Meanwhile, we catch up on the joys and difficult times of the past 7 years with Lia and Andrew.
Mike and Megan, a passionate pair of creatives are attempting to build a modernist house on a modest footprint. Mike designed the house himself to include only what they need and use.
Maree is the mother of three grown boys looking to sell her house on half an acre in outer western Sydney. It's a character-filled old weatherboard which needs a lot of work to make it market ready.

p.t: Love It Or List It Australia
p.d: Rob and Nikkis Waverley home is struggling as a family property. Andrew and Neale face a challenge unlike any they have tackled before.
Consultant Mark treats Meldred who was stabbed by a stranger when walking to school. Andrew presents some unusual symptoms when blood spots and a swollen ankle make it difficult for him to walk.
What do Britain's favourite opinionated viewers think of Strictly Come Dancing, The Lie Detective, Victoria, Celebrity Island with Bear Grylls, National Treasure, The X Factor and the News?
The Goggleboxers weigh in on I'm a Celebrity, Squid Game: The Challenge, All Her Fault, Celebrity Race Across the World, Picture Slam, Knife Edge and Emmerdale.
The series continues with Stranger Things, Strictly, Celebrity Scam Interceptors, Malice, Songs of Praise, CBeebies Bedtime Stories and Animals on Drugs.
Strictly, Changing Ends, One Shot with Ed Sheeran, All Her Fault, The Marvellous Miniature Workshop and Sara Davies' Christmas Craft Off.
Instead of traditional canvas or paper, learn how to paint on wood with Portrait Artist of the Year Series 7 Semi Finalist Alvin Kofi.

Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

Trees are Africa's oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals help these trees to reproduce by pollinating their flowers and dispersing their seed. African trees promote life, and form the backbone of one of Earths' most precious ecosystems.

Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

Trek to the planet's quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

Explore one of Earth's most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badger's risky dance with a deadly snake.

Go up against Australia's wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroo's deadly boxing moves and the redback spider's precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey's heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

Navigate the ocean's vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.

Explore the labour-intensive agricultural operations at the Smithsonian National Zoo. Acres of hay and bamboo are grown to help meet the needs of big eaters like the gorillas and bison, while also providing enrichment to a trio of lemurs.
Otters, siamangs and Sumatran tigers demonstrate how zoo food provides more than nutrition—it also stimulates playful behaviour that keeps animals more content.
Watch as zoo staff must focus their energy on two herds of asian elephants after one of the herds arrives from another zoo. Can food help these elephant families bond?
At the St Louis Zoo, feeding each animal has unique challenges, especially for the big eaters. See how staff feed the gorillas, an anaconda named J-Lo, cinereous vultures and the very hungry hippos.
Scott performs a surgical procedure on a cat with a fused jaw; the team makes a school visit to help goats; Scott's hairdresser questions him about his dog's issues.

Celebrate as Allie cashes in on a horse while Tammy shocks the barn by announcing her wedding is next weekend. Join a whirlwind dress-shopping spree and watch Megan take over Allie's lesson with Courtney—with less than stellar results.

Listen in as Dr. Scott gently delivers devastating news about Branston, his sister-in-law’s lovable puppy. Later, check out a baby budgie in trouble, and examine a strange growth that’s popped up on a cat’s head.

Chris returns to Hamilton, Victoria where the country vets give him the weird cases: Pepper the pig with stillborns, twin foals where mum's rejecting one, and measuring massive stud bulls' jewels for fertility.
Dr. Brown rushes to save a policeman's pet after it was poisoned with snail bait; a malnourished penguin washes up on Bondi Beach and is brought to the clinic.

Witness a shocking act of cruelty when the vets take on a 12-year-old cat deliberately left to die in the Bondi surf. Meet a depressed parrot caught up in a bizarre love triangle and watch Lisa help a Samoyed survive a killer tick bite.

Take a lesson in responsible canine ownership when the Atkinson family taps Beverley to help them bring home a brand new puppy. Learn if a Brussels griffon, a sheltie, or a toy Manchester terrier will be the best teacher for their three kids.

Feel the love as a little boy searches for a canine buddy he can call his own. Join the Bhattis and Beverley as they scope out cairn terriers, Dutch sheepdogs, and Yorkie-poos to see which furry bundle of joy will make a permanent connection.

Welcome back hope and joy with the Pascoe family, who are still grieving the recent passing of their first family pooch. Head out with Beverley to see if an Australian shepherd, a golden retriever, or a vizsla will mend their broken hearts.

Can cell phones cause dangerous gas station fires? Can a change in atmospheric pressure, experienced while flying have an effect on breast implants? And can CDs shatter in very high-speed drives?
Jamie and Adam recreate a widely known construction industry myth. Plus, can peeing on the third subway rail lead to electrocution? And can an eel skin wallet demagnetise credit cards?
The Myth: that a penny dropped from the top of the Empire State Building will be embedded in the concrete or asphalt below. If it strikes a poor pedestrian, it will shatter their skull and kill them.

Throughout history stories have been told of exhumed bodies and coffins that showed apparent signs of life after burial - like scratch marks on faces and inside coffin lids as the interred desperately tried to escape.

Mikey was challenged by his friends to eat six packs of POP Rocks Candy and Six cans of Soda. The carbon dioxide that makes the candy pop combined with the carbon dioxide in the soda to create so much pressure his stomach exploded.
Does wearing a tongue stud increase your chances of being struck by lightning? Can you build a a cannon out of a tree? And Adam and Jamie set out to bust the myth that you can fool the breathalyser.

What happens when a redneck faces off with a raccoon? According to this myth a drunken “good ole boy” poured gasoline down a drain to try and flush out a raccoon he was chasing. He crawled down the drain to light the gas and... boom!
In this episode, Jamie and Adam test out a world famous San Francisco myth, the escape from Alcatraz.

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if launching a chicken at an airplane will disrupt its flight and if a washing machine can really be deadly. They also explore the myth of the woman who swallowed an octopus egg then gave birth to an eight-legged offspring.

Special effects experts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman conduct experiments to try to determine if a person can become trapped in an airline toilet, if the biscuit bazooka really exists, and the truth behind the legend of the leaping lawyer.
We've all seen the Hollywood movies when a bad guy shoots a hole in a passenger jet and everyone gets sucked out the hole into the sky. Would it really happen?
Would a sinking ship pull you under? Titanic survivors said they rowed away from the vortex, and other sailors report the same—but is it true?
Can material in your toilet bowl aerate when flushed, and waft onto your toothbrush?
The MythBusters take on the Mob searching for Jimmy Hoffa, plus can a jet engine blow a car off the road and, is the daddy longlegs really the world's most venomous spider?
Larry Walters attached something like 45 weather balloons to this lawn chair. One of his tethers broke and he shot straight up into the air and apparently went up to about 16,0000 feet.

This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

Join guide Jean du Plessis for his first summit attempt on Mt. Kilimanjaro to see whether climate change has eroded its snowy peak. Learn about the pinnacle’s five climatic zones and search for clues that its volcanic heart is rumbling back to life.

Wildlife expert and safari guide Jean Du Plessis treks out to Mahale Mountains National Park, hoping to spend some time with the wild chimps living in the scrub of this remote and protected neck of the woods in Tanzania.
Watch mighty hippos and Nile crocodiles battle for survival in the place they both call home.
Evaluate the deadly weapons of poison dart frogs, piranhas, and mosquitoes.
Look at predators’ tool kits, killer bees, and bison who don’t like visitors.
Following the devastating tsunami of 2011, Japan is going through a seismic crisis. Here, get a closer look at two of the country's most dangerous volcanoes.
Witness the harsh realities that shape hippo life on Zambia's Luangwa River.
The wetland landscapes of southern Africa are home to a rich tapestry of life.This is usually a land of plenty but for the last 20 years, the St Lucia area has received below average rainfall.
The magnificent jaguar is the largest cat in all of the Americas. In Brazil, it reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.
In the Pantanal, the wonderful ocelot appears to be making a comeback. A team of scientists try to figure out the clues to its resurgence.
The white-whiskered spider monkey is one of the most intelligent and agile creatures in the New World, and dwells happily within a protected Brazilian forest.
Finding a home in new territory is a challenge, but sometimes, animals have no choice. Using sheer numbers to impose their will, these are nature's unwanted guests.

Off the southern coast of Australia, Western grey kangaroos thrive on the predator-free Kangaroo Island, aptly named for its unique inhabitants. To the south lies Phillip Island, a sanctuary for the world's smallest penguin species. Embark on a journey to discover some of nature's most hospitable havens for animals.

p.d: A very uncooperative suspect heeds the voice of his more level headed relative and finally follows officers instructions. Police question a couple of known drug users. And a suspect's drugs are uncovered.
