From limited fishing days to lower prices and with only one buyer break left, Hard Merchandise is out to prove they deserve another win after so many bad seasons, but Paul and his crew will do anything to have a shot at the title on Wicked Pissah.
Bluefin season in Gloucester is open and the fleet is ready to bounce back from last year's low prices and cash in on a brighter future.

The fleet’s livelihood is on the line as they attempt to control what bites their hook. Pinwheel fights to stay ahead after captain Tyler McLaughlin discovers a mechanical issue on the boat. Tyler and his mate Marissa work together to try and control the chaos in order to catch. Meanwhile, struggling for their first tuna of the season, Dot Com takes an unusual gamble and chases the bite, while the rest of the fleet battle to get ahead.

In a fleet filled with champions, the pressure is on for previous winners to reclaim their titles. Hard Merch is seeking redemption for coming in second last season, while Fat Tuna battles to take the top spot away from Pinwheel. Meanwhile, last season’s winner, Wicked Pissah, struggles to catch their first fish, and defend their title.
As TJ awaits news on the health of his beloved Reba, his crew tries to catch Hot Tuna their first fish of the season.
As some of the fleet make the biggest pay cheques they've seen in years, last season's reigning champion Paul Hebert aims to catch his first fish of this season.
The Dotcom crew works their way through back-to-back obstacles, hoping for a comeback.

Time Flies, Fat Tuna and Dot Com are on a blue fin hot streak, while Hot Tuna, Moonshine and Hard Merchandise lag behind. But, these veteran captains plan to use their experience and a little luck to break their slump. Will Hot Tuna’s lucky charm help them? Will Moonshine recover from unexpected mishaps? Will Hard Merchandise score a blue fin with new techniques? Find out who scores and who fails on Wicked Tuna.

When morale is low and exhaustion kicks in, mounting stress on the Pinwheel causes a rift that could break the brother and sister team. Captain Tyler McLaughlin must juggle more responsibilities after disagreements with his mate and sister Marissa jeopardize the success of catching a giant Bluefin. Meanwhile, the fleet spreads out along the Atlantic coast to find the biggest and best quality Bluefin of the season.

On this episode, teamwork is the name of the game. But some crews work better together than others. While Jack and Nick on Time Flies pull together to try and prove their worth in the fleet, last year’s champions on the Wicked Pissah are falling apart under the pressure to perform. Which team will reign supreme?
After a season of frustration, tension boils over on the Wicked Pissah.

Fishing for Atlantic Bluefin isn’t a sprint, it’s a marathon, as Pinwheel’s Tyler and Marissa get pushed beyond their limits. Battling their largest tuna in the longest, most challenging fish fight so far this season, everything that can go wrong, does. As other captains grapple with equally massive monsters, it all comes down to who will turn their big ambitions into even bigger fish and prove that the struggle is worth the pain?
Some captains are having their luckiest seasons to date, but the fleet's fate is in the hands of the tuna Gods, regardless of skill and determination.

With the season more than half over, experience and youth battle it out for bluefin tuna. Young cousins on Hard Merchandise are out to prove their abilities. While ‘Father Tuna’ on Moonshine turns a greenhorn into a quick learner. But, as seasoned father figures pass down winning techniques, will the reliable rod on Dot Com and the underdogs on Time Flies be able to keep their leads?

Captain TJ Ott takes an expensive risk to go double or nothing. Down on their luck, Hot Tuna works together with BadFish to catch more Bluefin and make a profit for the family business. Meanwhile, the fleet takes risks that could ruin their chances at victory, and Hard Merch works to prove to the fleet that they deserve a place at the top.
